reviews.text:
I visited because of the Blue Archive collaboration.

I was lucky enough to get set B, and the photo card I wanted was Yuuka Himari. Luckily hehe

There are a lot of people because of the collaboration, so I recommend coming at opening time.

[Additional review in November 2023]

In November 23, I visited Golden Crema once again in collaboration with Myeongil Ark.

Personally, I felt like there were more people because I went on a weekend than the Blue Archive Mika collaboration that I went to on a weekday, and I felt like I was much better at managing the number of people waiting than I was at the previous collaboration event.

However, I was personally dissatisfied with the insufficient quantity of goods and service.
The service I was not satisfied with was that there were 4 types of set menus, but when I ordered, they said that only Set B Lemon & Pocky was available, so many people came and thought that was the only option, but when I went later, they said I could order all menus. To be honest, it was a bit absurd, and I thought it would have been better if they had provided additional explanation if they were selling it over time. Neither the boss nor the employees explained anything.
And I still think the quantity of goods was insufficient for me personally. However, I don't really care about this because it may have been insufficient due to the large number of people visiting and purchasing, but I hope that the above problem will change in the future.
And I don't know if drinks are usually served in cans, but I was surprised to see that they gave me lemon tea in cans.

Still, it was nice to collaborate with my favorite game, 'Myeongil Ark', and I hope to do another collaboration event like this in the future.

One line review - Indonesian coffee shop located on Red Road in Hongdae

Coffee taste - Actually, it's not at a sommelier level, so I don't know the exact difference between the coffee beans, but the coffee aroma is strong. It's just delicious. The menu itself is creamy and sweet, so I think a lot of people will like it.

Item - I want a coaster because it is such a unique concept. A pleasure for the mouth and eyes.

Bakery - It tastes like a standard, ready-made product. The coffee feels even more special because it has a moderate taste that is neither too flashy nor too memorable.

Friendliness - The staff were friendly and greeted me well when coming in and leaving, so I had a pleasant stay. If I come again, I think I will come with joy and anticipation.

Personal review - I'll have to try the food next time. Personally, the coffee, atmosphere, and service were perfect, but the bakery was a bit disappointing.

It is very cozy and quiet, so it is a place where you can enjoy inner peace. In the Hongdae commercial area!

There are many different types of tea, and you can enjoy them with a proper tea set. It's been a long time since I tried drinking Dongbangmiin, which I used to enjoy. It's good too.

I lost track of time as I drank tea in a comfortable space, smelling the fragrant tea. It seems like they sell quite good quality Hangwa, not just cheap Hangwa. I recommend enjoying it with tea.

There is Kami Udon right next door, so I really like the route of eating udon, then moving to Durrecha next door and enjoying tea as dessert. I need to use this route often ^^ I need to take turns drinking different types of tea. (In addition to traditional teas, it's also good to have a list of unique milk teas. I'm looking forward to it since there are few places that make milk tea properly.)

2021.12.10 Boy Milk Tea. Haha, the taste is really unique. A taste I don't want to drink again.

There were so many different types and it was hard to decide what to eat, but I decided on the most signature dish.
It's nice that you can set the amount of ice and sweetness, so you can eat it to suit your taste.

reviews.author: Nana
reviews.text: It's a place with a real Taiwanese feel. It seemed like there were a lot of not only Korean customers but also Taiwanese customers. In addition to milk tea, I was able to taste a variety of Taiwanese teas, and it was really nice that they also sold my favorite Donggwa tea! You can also add jellyfish as a topping, and since I don't drink milk, I tried to order soy milk milk tea, but I heard that soy milk milk tea also contains powdered milk, so I added pearls to the soy milk black tea, but please give me a lot of pearls too! There are a few places to sit on the second floor, but it has a glass floor, so you need to be careful when wearing short pants!

reviews.author: Libby Yu
reviews.text:
Delicious milk tea, delicious pearls! It has a variety of menus, and is visited by more Chinese speakers than Koreans.

Alishan Oolong Milk Tea is the best seller,
Personally, it was the most delicious when I ordered brown sugar jelly + milk injeolmi + 30% sugar + 0% ice.

This is a delicious bubble tea restaurant.
When you enter, you can smell the faint scent of medicinal herbs.

At Just B Temple, staff provide tea throughout the day. Tea is served in carefully prepared tea cups, creating a beautiful atmosphere. Since the tea was donated to the temple, it is also interesting that you can taste tea from various countries. I highly recommend stopping by at least once a day! You'll always be able to chat with our friendly staff.

reviews.text: You can drink high-quality cocktails at low prices. Although it is not a romantic atmosphere, the techno-inspired interior seems to be suitable for gatherings with friends. The unique cyberpunk-style interior is a bonus.

reviews.author: Chris Kwon Lewis
reviews.text:
I had high expectations when I saw that there was a cyberpunk bar. However, I was disappointed that the only things related to cyberpunk were wall decorations and a few cyberpunk images on TV.

The cocktail menu was quite limited, and it was disappointing that there were no cyberpunk-related signature cocktails. Why not Jackie Wells, Johnny Silverhand, and David Martinez cocktails?

The music also didn't fit the cyberpunk atmosphere at all. Almost every song was Coldplay. There was no cyberpunk-related music at all. Why can't there be a Cyberpunk OST or a Blade Runner OST? Music that was somewhat related to cyberpunk would have been fine.

Additionally, there were animation props hanging on the walls that did not fit the cyberpunk atmosphere at all.

I think this bar could have huge potential if it were to deliver an immersive cyberpunk experience. I want to feel like I'm in a bar in Night City. If this bar is built properly, cyberpunk fans from all over the world will come to visit.

What I can say positively is that my old fashion is well made and a great place to take pictures from the right angle. The cyberpunk circuit board style wall is well done and looks much better in photos than it does in person. I wish the boss would change the atmosphere and play music that suits him better than Coldplay.

I was surprised that the female employee or the owner responded so unkindly as soon as I arrived. I don't even want to give the service a 1 star rating. I understand that you may be in a bad mood due to a personal matter, but I don't understand why you are taking out your anger on the customer.
When taking your order or first showing you to your seat, you respond with all kinds of irritated tone and rotten expressions! The atmosphere was very chill because they were ticking the whole time.
And why are there so many menus that don't work? They need to change the menu too.
The cocktail was just a pretty cocktail for an Instagrammable shot. It looked good and didn't taste good. I went for a drink at the end of the year and had the worst experience. I don't recommend it!

reviews.author: wheel
reviews.text: Since it was opening time, we were the only ones there, but before we could even sit down, they asked for our ID in an annoyed tone and since there were a lot of people (there were 6 people), we asked if we could sit on the sofa seats, and when we asked if we could sit on the sofa, they refused, saying that there were seats for 10. However, there were 5 people who came in around the time we left, so they let us sit there. He refused the cocktail I ordered once, probably because it was a hassle to make, and left with a sigh. Do you not want to do business? And is it because they want to kick us out that they demand prepayment without any explanation as soon as we order the set? Other tables didn't say that.^^* If you're going to treat us like this, why don't you accept us from the beginning? I came to the last place I was looking forward to and was in a bad mood.

J’s Bar in Korea is like a hidden gem! The atmosphere is cozy and the staff are really friendly. I had a frozen piña colada with a strong pineapple flavor, and it was really delicious with the cute bear-shaped decoration on top!

The drinks are top notch and you have to order if you want to drink them on site, but it's a small shop so that's totally understandable. Overall 9 out of 10! Highly recommended if you want to have a fun evening! 🌸
